claims.quote: The jelly bean tetra, Ladigesia roloffi, is a small alestid from Sierra Leone, known with certainty only from the Kasewe Forest reserve.
A single record from the Du river drainage in the Firestone rubber plantation near Harbel, Liberia (Van den Nieuwenhuisen, 1972), also exists.

regions.name: Gbangbaia
regions.quote: This species' distribution is unclear and it's only known with certainty from the type locality 'Kasewe Forest, Sierra Leone' where it's said to inhabit the upper Gbangbaia river basin.

regions.name: Du
regions.quote: A single record from the Du river drainage in the Firestone rubber plantation near Harbel, Liberia (Van den Nieuwenhuisen, 1972), also exists.
